expertise.item: React Native / Expo Ecosystem (Deep internal knowledge of expo-av)

instruction_block.mission: Implement a state-of-the-art "Direct-to-Intent" Voice Logging feature for the Workout App. Critically, do NOT use a separate Speech-to-Text (STT) service like Whisper. Leverage the native audio understanding capabilities of Gemini 1.5 Flash to go directly from AUDIO -> structured JSON.

context.current_architecture: - Frontend: Expo Go (React Native) - Backend: Supabase Edge Functions - Parsing Service: Exists at `lib/services/parser/extractor-service.ts`
context.constraints: - Must remain compatible with Expo Go (No native code compilation required). - Audio Format: AAC (.m4a) for bandwidth efficiency. - Latency: Minimize round-trips.

step.name: Frontend Audio Recorder
step.requirements: - Use `expo-av` for recording. - Preset: `Audio.RecordingOptionsPresets.HIGH_QUALITY` (adjust to AAC/m4a output). - Visual Feedback: Simple pulsing animation or red indicator when recording. - Permissions: Handle microphone permission requests gracefully.

step.name: Service Layer Integration
step.requirements: - Function `recordAudio()`: Handles start/stop. - Function `uploadAudio(uri)`: Sends file to Supabase Edge Function. - Integration with `ExtractorService`: Extend it to accept 'audio' type.

step.name: Intelligent Caching (Edge Function)
step.requirements: - Implement SHA-256 hashing of incoming file buffers. - Check a new Supabase table `extraction_cache` (hash, result, created_at). - IF hash exists: Return stored JSON (Cost = $0). - IF hash new: Proceed to AI extraction, then store result. - Add support for **Gemini Context Caching** for the stable part of the system prompt to reduce token costs.

step.name: Backend Intelligence
step.requirements: - Update the existing function to detect `audio/*` mime types. - Construct a Gemini Prompt specific for audio: "Listen to this workout log. The user may be out of breath or using slang. Extract the exercises, sets, reps, and weights into this JSON structure..." - Ensure the `inlineData` part of the generative AI payload handles the audio bytes correctly.

step.name: UI Integration
step.requirements: - Add a floating action button (FAB) or prominent mic icon to trigger recording. - On success, navigate to the existing `ImportReviewScreen` with the parsed data.

instruction_block.output_format: Provide the complete type-safe code for each step. Ensure error handling is robust (e.g., "Microphone access denied", "Transcription failed"). Add comments explaining the "Direct Multimodal" approach for future maintainers.
